tagline: Art prints from a small studio

posts.title: New: The Riso Moon Run
content: Fifty copies, two colors, one slightly temperamental risograph. The Riso Moon print is finally in the shop.
Each one comes out a little different — that is the riso promise and the riso threat. Numbers 1 through 50, signed.
comments: Number 7 arrived today. The misregistration is perfect.
